steps: From repo root /projects/sandbox/krtk.rs run `cargo check --workspace`. This may compile many dependencies on first run; allow it to finish.
If `cargo check --workspace` succeeds, the baseline is green. Record the result in this feature's findings.

Do not attempt to fix unrelated pre-existing failures.

Baseline state is documented so post-change verification can be compared against it.
